I am 76, and my household is small, so I will not spread myself too thin or chase anything complicated. I will put 4.5 mu into winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land, and I will keep 2 mu in cotton. For wheat, I will use improved seed and moderate fertilizer so I can get a stable harvest without wasting money. For maize, I will use hybrid seed because I care most about reliable yield in summer. For cotton, I will keep the area smaller because it takes more labor, but I still want some cash income from it. I will rely on rotary tillage and simple field operations, use irrigation only when I think the crop really needs it, and keep pesticide sprays to a moderate level so I can control pests without overspending.
